# Chief Tools Documentation

> Documentation files for Large Language Models

## Documentation

- [Support](https://docs.chief.tools/support.md): Needs help with Chief Tools? Find the right resources here.
- [Security](https://docs.chief.tools/security.md): Found a security issue? Here's how to report it and what to expect from us.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/introduction.md): Everything Chief Tools, learn about how the Chief Tools work and how to use them
- [Bots](https://docs.chief.tools/bots.md): A quick introduction to Chief Tools bots, what they do and how you can detect them.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/flowguard/introduction.md): A quick introduction to FlowGuard, what it does and how to use it.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/tny/introduction.md): A quick introduction to Tny, what it does and how to use it.
- [Custom Domains](https://docs.chief.tools/tny/custom-domains.md): Learn how to use Custom Domains with Tny
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/introduction.md): A quick introduction to Domain Chief, what it does and how to use it.
- [AI](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/ai.md): Connect Domain Chief to your AI agent and manage domains with MCP.
- [Server Setup](https://docs.chief.tools/deploychief/server-setup.md): To take full advantage of Deploy Chief a little work is needed on your side.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/deploychief/introduction.md): A quick introduction to Deploy Chief, what it does and how to use it.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/certchief/introduction.md): A quick introduction to Cert Chief, what it does and how to use it.
- [Bot information](https://docs.chief.tools/certchief/bot.md): Learn what the Cert Chief bot does, why it may connect to your services, and how to identify it.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/billdo/introduction.md): A quick introduction to Bill.DO, what it does and how to use it.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://docs.chief.tools/billdo/frequently-asked-questions.md): Answers to frequently asked questions about Bill.DO.
- [Tokens](https://docs.chief.tools/api/tokens.md): Learn about Chief Tools tokens and how to use and secure them.
- [Scopes](https://docs.chief.tools/api/scopes.md): Learn how scopes control what OAuth clients and API tokens can access across Chief Tools.
- [OAuth Discovery](https://docs.chief.tools/api/discovery.md): OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 discovery metadata for Account Chief.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/accountchief/introduction.md): A quick introduction to Account Chief, what it does and how to use it.
- [Scopes](https://docs.chief.tools/tny/api/scopes.md): Available API scopes for Tny and which endpoints they control.
- [Testing with .example](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/developers/example-tld.md): Learn how to use the .example TLD to test Domain Chief's API and UI features without real domain registration costs.
- [Domain Connect](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/developers/domain-connect.md): Learn how to integrate your service with Domain Chief domains using the Domain Connect protocol for automated DNS configuration.
- [Scopes](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/api/scopes.md): Available API scopes for Domain Chief and which endpoints they control.
- [Metadata](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/api/metadata.md): Learn how to attach custom metadata to domains, contacts, and DNS records via the Domain Chief API.
- [Introduction](https://docs.chief.tools/domainchief/api/introduction.md): A quick introduction to the Domain Chief API, what it does and how to use it.
- [Scopes](https://docs.chief.tools/accountchief/api/scopes.md): Available identity and account scopes managed by Account Chief.
